q: The best method of making a magnet is to use the ____ of an electric current.
e: Current is charge per second. Conventional current is opposite to electron drift. The best method of making a magnet is to use the magnetic effect of an electric current.

q: When a large current flows through the solenoid the steel bar becomes magnetized ____.
e: A current makes a magnetic field. Soft iron in a solenoid is a temporary magnet; reverse the current and the poles flip. When a large current flows through the solenoid the steel bar becomes magnetized permanently.

q: Such a magnet is called a ____.
e: Such a magnet is called a permanent magnet. The name used here is permanent magnet.

q: A ____ surrounded by a coil of wire, which acts as a magnet when a current flows through the coil is called a temporary magnet (or) an electromagnet.
e: A current makes a magnetic field. Soft iron in a solenoid is a temporary magnet; reverse the current and the poles flip. A soft iron core surrounded by a coil of wire, which acts as a magnet when a current flows through the coil is called a temporary magnet (or) an electromagnet.

q: It is ____ when the current stops.
e: It is demagnetized when the current stops. Demagnetized is what this statement is using.

q: Increasing the current will create a ____ magnetic field strength.
e: Increasing the current will create a stronger magnetic field strength. Stronger is what this statement is using.

q: Reversing the direction of current will ____ the direction of magnetic field.
e: Reversing the direction of current will reverse the direction of magnetic field. Reverse is what this statement is using.

q: An ____ is an example of the use of the magnetic effect of current.
e: Current can heat a wire, drive electrolysis, or magnetize a core. Those three effects are used in lamps, plating, and electromagnets. An electric bell is an example of the use of the magnetic effect of current.

q: A ____ is also another example of the use of the magnetic effect of current.
e: Current can heat a wire, drive electrolysis, or magnetize a core. Those three effects are used in lamps, plating, and electromagnets. A circuit breaker is also another example of the use of the magnetic effect of current.

q: The electromagnet will attract the iron armature if the current is large, thus ____ the circuit.
e: A current makes a magnetic field. Soft iron in a solenoid is a temporary magnet; reverse the current and the poles flip. The electromagnet will attract the iron armature if the current is large, thus breaking the circuit.
